parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the IDs of hybrid cloud clusters.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time is in UTC.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time is in UTC.

parameters.name: UserStatusList
parameters.description:
The list of risk states for which to collect statistics.

> By default, statistics are collected for risks in the **toBeConfirmed**, **toBeFixed**, **toBeVerified**, and **notFixed** states.
